title: CustomNotificationType - Tooling API
description: Stores information about custom notification types. This object is available in API version 46.0 and later.
supported_soap_calls: `create(), delete(), describeSObjects(), query(), retrieve(), update(), upsert()`, `create()`, `delete()`, `describeSObjects()`, `query()`, `retrieve()`, `update()`, `upsert()`

CustomNotifTypeName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Unique, Update
CustomNotifTypeName.description: Specifies a notification type name. The notification type name is unique within your organization. Maximum number of characters: 80.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: Specifies a general description of the notification type, which is displayed with the notification type name. Maximum number of characters: 255.

Desktop.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
Desktop.description: Indicates whether the desktop delivery channel is enabled (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

DeveloperName.description: Specifies the API name of the notification type.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Language.description: Specifies the language of the custom notification type. The value for this field is the language value of the org.

ManageableState.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ManageableState.description: Indicates the manageable state of the specified component that is contained in a package: beta deleted deprecated deprecatedEditable installed installedEditable released unmanaged

Mobile.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
Mobile.description: Indicates whether the mobile delivery channel is enabled (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

NamespacePrefix.description: Specifies the namespace of the notification type, if installed with a managed package.
